title: Mario finds his right B-52 pilot glove missing from his bag
summary: Mario Woods tells of Mario finds his right B-52 pilot glove missing from his bag, about 1977 at Ellsworth AFB / Mario's home, Rapid City, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB / Mario's home, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I did everything. And my left hand glove was there, but the right hand glove is gone.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says that in 1977, while serving at Ellsworth, an Air Force base near Rapid City, South Dakota, he went through his bag back home and found something wrong. His left glove from flying the B-52, a large Air Force bomber, was there, but the right one was gone. He tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels next to a fellow veteran, Michael Johnson, because he links the missing glove to a night he and Johnson say they were taken by beings, so if true the glove would be a physical trace of that night.
